versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the paper-deep-dive skill.
- Enables structured, evidence-driven, reader-friendly deep dives into single papers.
- Prioritizes research context, method intuition/formalism, and claim-to-evidence mapping.
- Introduces clearly defined output structure and deep dive modes, including handling for input limitations.
- Emphasizes honest uncertainty, explicit citation of evidence, and critical analysis of method and experiments.
- Optimized for generating high-quality blog, presentation, or internal discussion materials from academic papers.
